evals.name: ingest-fresh-clippings
evals.prompt: Ingest the fresh clippings sitting in raw/ into the wiki.
evals.note: Runs against a SANDBOX copy of the vault at /tmp/ai-wiki-sandbox so the real wiki is untouched. Two fresh clippings await: 'CSS-native parallax effect.md' and 'Simplified Index Management.md'.

assertions.text: Creates a source summary page under wiki/sources/ for each of the 2 fresh clippings
Each source page has frontmatter with type: source, an ingested: date, and a source_file pointing into raw/Clippings/processed/
Creates or updates at least one concept or entity page for notable content
New entity/concept pages carry cluster tags (e.g. web-development, knowledge-management) so they land in a Glossary view
Adds entries to wiki/index.md for the new pages
Appends at least one ingest entry to wiki/log.md
Moves both clippings into raw/Clippings/processed/ and adds processed tag + ingested date to their frontmatter
Does not edit the body text of the raw clippings beyond adding processed/ingested frontmatter
